text:
Alex P: Quick status — I'm handing off the usage accounting/event schema work. Putting up a short checklist and owners so we can close out the milestone.
Maria G: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the final schema snippet here? also need the target rollout date.
Alex P: Target rollout = EOD Friday (2026-03-20). Schema draft below (new fields bolded):
```
ingest.event_type: string
ingest.model_id: string\ingest.request_tokens: int
ingest.response_tokens: int
billing.token_cost_usd: float  # derived per-request cost (post-attribution)
attrib.path: [string]  # routing labels used for cost split
```
Samir R: Quick question on `billing.token_cost_usd` — is that computed in the ingestion pipeline or the attribution job?
Alex P: Attribution job (post-ingest). Ingest will emit token counts and model_id. Attribution service will join with pricing and routing labels to produce `billing.token_cost_usd`.
Jen L: Who owns the attribution job? I thought platform owned ingest and analytics owned attribution. Confirming owners so infra changes don't slip.
Priya S: Analytics owns attribution (+ regression tests). Eng-platform owns ingest, event contracts, and deployment hooks.
Alex P: Yep — owners: eng-platform = @Jen L for ingest contract and deploy, analytics = @Priya S for attribution logic and tests. I'll cc both on PR.
Maria G: Any downstream dashboards that will break? We need a migration plan if field names change.
Samir R: Dashboards using `token_*` fields will read the same counts. The only new field is `billing.token_cost_usd`. Add a feature flag (query-time) for early rollout.
Jen L: I'll add a feature flag in ingest that toggles emitting `attrib.path` until analytics flips it on.
Alex P: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/ingest/merge_requests/456 — includes schema bump + emit toggle. Please review.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for canary window Thu 09:00 -> 11:00 UTC if PR green.
Priya S: I'll open analytics PR tomorrow with unit tests + a small eval to validate cost numbers on sample data.
Maria G: +1 on audit log entries for price changes. Who tracks pricing source?
Samir R: Pricing table owned by finance-service (svc:pricing). Attribution will fetch a snapshot daily; analytics will surface a price-change alert.
Alex P: Blockers: 1) infra quota for canary GPUs? (unlikely but check), 2) need signoff from security on emitting `attrib.path` if it contains customer labels.
Jen L: I'll ping infra and security. If `attrib.path` has PII we will hash upstream; otherwise keep as-is.
Priya S: I'll review sample payloads and redact any PII before attribution job runs.
Alex P: Thanks. Action items: Jen add feature flag + coordinate canary window; Priya open analytics PR + tests; Maria validate dashboards + audit hooks; Samir confirm pricing snapshot cadence. I'll follow up tomorrow with a brief sync note. :thumbsup:
Maria G: Sounds good. Marking owners in the milestone — will update JIRA.
Jen L: Reviewing PR now.
Priya S: I'll queue the eval and tag the analytics-oncall.
Alex P: End of thread — ping me if anything blocks.
